|lead='''Captain Gilad Pellaeon''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] released as a super-rare foil in [[Reflections III]] in October 2001.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Complete Card List v4.0], pp. 28–32 (collecting compilation). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Reflections product entry (collecting reference). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> It is a foil printing of the [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] card.<ref name="foil-face">[[:File:Reflections-III-Foil-D-Captain-Gilad-Pellaeon-SWCA-photo-68362-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections III foil face]], Duncan Jenkins, Star Wars Collectors Archive.</ref>
|lore=Corellian leader. Lied about his age to enter the Academy. Took command of Chimaera when its captain was killed at the Battle of Endor. Admires Grand Admiral Thrawn.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Deploys for free to Thrawn’s location. Each other Imperial aboard same capital starship is forfeit +2. Adds 2 to power of any capital starship he pilots (3 if Chimaera). While aboard Chimaera with Thrawn, also adds 2 to that starship’s armor and hyperspeed.<ref name="foil-face" />
|released=31 October 2001<ref name="reflections-iii-decipher-radio">Decipher, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015005643id_/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NNs4EIaZywE Radio Free Decipher 103], 2 November 2001, 0:35–0:39.</ref>
